about_the_game:
✦ Max Twist ✦

Ride the future of extreme sports in VR. Strap onto your hoverboard and dive through neon-lit, sci-fi tracks packed with obstacles, walls, and gravity-defying twists. Chase speed records, chain fluid combos, and push for the perfect run to a pulsing electronic soundtrack. Inspired by 1080° Snowboarding and F-Zero, Max Twist reimagines high-speed racing for the space age.

Choose between the Casual Circuit for a relaxed ride or the Pro Circuit for razor-sharp competition against your best times and friends’ scores. Every course is built to test your reflexes—stay balanced, keep twisting, and prove you’re in control.

Features

  • 27 total tracks: 18 official courses plus 9 brand-new slalom runs

  • Over 40 music tracks to fuel your ride with nonstop energy

  • Latest update: upgraded graphics, improved sound effects, and sharper immersion

  • Tutorial & Learn More menus to get you started fast, even as a beginner

  • Sci-fi spaceship hub for course and soundtrack selection

  • VR touch-based menus designed for immersion and ease of use

  • Broad headset support: HTC Vive, HTC Cosmos, Meta Quest (via Link/Air Link), Quest 2, Quest 3, HTC Cosmos, Oculus Rift, and most SteamVR-compatible headsets

name: Max Twist

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB GTX or AMD Graphics that is VR ready
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5 channel surround
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Oculus Quest, Oculus Rift, Oculus Rift S, HTC VIve, HTC Vive Pro, HTC Vive Elite, HTC Cosmos
  • Additional Notes: Should work on all Oculus/Meta and HTC headsets. More VR Support to be added during early access
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Graphics: 8 GB RTX or AMD Graphics that is VR ready
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5 channel surround
  • VR Support: HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, HTC Cosmos
  • Additional Notes: More VR Support to be added during EA, SteamVR, Index, Input Mapping
